description: Abstract Tool Permissions Model for MCP and System Tools

permissions.description: Search public internet and web search engines
Execute scoped SELECT queries via MCP database adapter
Execute mutation queries (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) on authorized tables
Parse unstructured PDFs, tables, and docs via Docling/OCR
Read storage artifacts from authorized bucket namespaces
Write storage artifacts to authorized task staging buckets
Synthesize or refactor code files in sandbox workspace
Execute automated test suites and linters in sandbox
Assemble deployment manifests and container builds
Deploy applications or microservices to production nodes
Generate graphic images, diagrams, and thumbnails
Render motion video assets via local FFmpeg tool
Generate voiceover audio, soundscapes, or music stems
Prepare social media posts, descriptions, and tags
Publish live public content to external platforms (YouTube, Facebook, etc.)
Draft email communications and newsletters
Dispatch outbound emails to external recipients
Read GitHub issues, PRs, and repositories
Push commits, open PRs, or modify repository settings
Read CPU, RAM, queue backlog, and node telemetry
Manage database credentials, secrets, and system configurations
